title: Accent family via accentPrefix/accentSuffix (v24)
description: MNX v24 encodes the sforzando family structurally rather than as opaque glyph names: accentPrefix + value + accentSuffix + residualValue concatenate to the conventional abbreviation, so s+f+z is sfz, r+f+z is rfz, ""+f+z is fz, s+f+"" is sf, ""+f+""+p is fp and s+f+z+p is sfzp. This scenario engraves all six. It is invalid by design: the published v24 schema stores the dynamic-prefix and dynamic-suffix enum values with literal quote characters, so it rejects accentPrefix "s" and accepts only "\"s\"" — the pinned errors are that rejection. Every mark here validates against the corrected schema, so this exhibit retires when the fix lands upstream.
